name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.4 degrees south of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 15 times in 4 visits over 29 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 28 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 29 hours starting 2026-05-20, at wavelengths from 1.59 to 4.82 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
